$comment: MF-42 (FE-31; plan.min cut 5, P42-D9 a): the one data home of the binding boundary. libraries = the MaxBLD-new UI packages (one tier); they may be imported only by a listed binding module, a listed provider, a test file or the vendor dir. A converted surface's mount file (mounts[]) may import only a framework package (framework[]), a binding module or a project-internal path (mount_internal[], relative paths included), never a UI library or any other package. modules[] are exact .tsx files under the R-13 component roots, each owned by a promoted platform_shared census entry (promoted_entries[]). ref_kinds and non_display_keys judge golden props (SV-SBIND); widget_types judges render.form (SV-DESC). Shape: screen-data.schema.json#/definitions/bindings. Read by scripts/surfaces/screen-checks.mjs and the FE-31 and FE-05 locks. Dated note 2026-11-09 (MF-37; D-23, ~/Buildo-scratch/DECISIONS-PREAPPROVED-20261108.md): mapping.web is the closed list of JSX element names each web binding module may render per archetype (FE-31 C-8); RJSF's Mantine theme renders FileInput, NumberInput, TextInput, Select and the submit Button itself, so those names document what a FORM shows rather than JSX in our modules. touch_targets.web lists the Mantine size values that reach 44 px (FE-31 C-9), measured from @mantine/core 9.8.0: inputs and Button lg 50 px, xl 60 px; CloseButton and ActionIcon lg 34 px, xl 44 px. ref_kinds gains contract (FE-32): a golden value {"contract": "<contract_id>.<field>"} names a field of a CONTRACT descriptor's inputs.field_whitelist. Dated note 2026-11-09 (MF-37; operator "a, 1-3 approved"): the web library is Mantine 8.3.18 / mantine-datatable 8.3.13; the touch_targets values were re-measured on @mantine/core 8.3.18 styles.css (--button-height-lg and --input-height-lg 3.125rem, xl 3.75rem; --cb-size-xl and --ai-size-xl 2.75rem = 44 px) and are unchanged. Dated note 2026-11-10 (MF-35; the binding standard, Spec 126 §11b.2 dated note 2026-11-10 item (5); plan ~/Buildo-scratch/mcfrontend/MF-35/plan.v3.md §2): the first mobile binding. modules gains mobile/src/components/surfaces/SurfaceRenderer.tsx and SearchBinding.tsx (archetype SEARCH, owner shared_mobile_surface_binding, promoted); mounts gains the search screen; mount_internal gains @/hooks/ and @/store/ (the screen reads the lookup hook and the recent-searches store); edges is the safe-area EdgeRecord {top: additive}, equal to the legacy edges [top] (an array of strings under a non-display key reads as display text to SV-SBIND); ref_kinds gains derived (P35-D14 a: a declared deviation with a closed list of names, checked by the mobile golden test); non_display_keys gains the React Native prop names that carry no display text (measured with SV-SBIND on the goldens). mapping.mobile.SEARCH is the closed component table of SurfaceRenderer.tsx: its COMPONENTS literal has exactly these keys, each an imported library part (FE-31 C-8 mobile half). touch_targets.mobile names the className token that reaches 44 px on Button and Input: NativeWind's rem is 14 here, so min-h-11 is 38.5 px and only min-h-[44px] is 44 (plan v2 F-A; FE-31 C-9 mobile half). Dated note 2026-11-10 (MF-40; operator, verbatim: "y recommendation: C, with the four trims. approved"; plan delta 1 section 3 item 5 and S3): mapping.web.FORM gains Textarea and DateInput, which RJSF's Mantine theme renders for the offer form's textarea and date widgets (documentation of what a FORM shows, as for the other RJSF names; no Checkbox: trim 4). mounts gain the admin placements page files. MF-44 (dated 2026-11-11; operator "01-a 0-2 b as long as they are complaint"; Spec 126 §11b.5): + the web SEARCH module src/components/surfaces/web/SearchBinding.tsx (owner binding_web_search), mapping.web.SEARCH, the web search mounts (the page, its client mount, the not-found and error boundaries of src/app/(maxbld)/parcel-tool) and the parcel-tool provider layout. Dated note 2026-11-11 (MF-48; operator, verbatim: "just to understand for the McFrontend and the web pages we are still using schema's and no code. except all recommendations"; ~/Buildo-scratch/mcfrontend/MF-48/DECISIONS.md D-2 a, D-3 a, D-4 a; Spec 126 §11b.2 and §11b.4 dated notes 2026-11-11): the mobile REPORT binding. modules gains ReportBinding.tsx and ReportPageHost.tsx (archetype REPORT, owner binding_mobile_report, promoted); the shared renderer SurfaceRenderer.tsx lists SEARCH and REPORT (the one-archetype rule amended for the render half only). mapping.mobile.REPORT is the renderer's closed REPORT list (a subset of its SEARCH parts, so its COMPONENTS table is unchanged); mapping.mobile.REPORT_HOST is the host's table (FE-31 C-8m host list: the existing @gorhom/bottom-sheet and the shared renderer; libraries.mobile is not extended, a lane finding: seven Buildo-app files import the sheet). ref_kinds gains part ({"part": "<section id>.<part index>.<role>"} into MF-57's pageViewOf view; <id>.ad.value|disclosure). non_display_keys gains option and panel (the toggle_panel action's arguments) and pressBehavior (the sheet backdrop), measured on the MF-48 goldens and host. Dated note 2026-11-11 (MF-53; operator 2026-11-11, verbatim: "\"choose your lot\" and \"address issues\" screens should be built now and we should only be using the new report obviosuly"; plan ~/Buildo-scratch/mcfrontend/MF-53/plan.v4.md §3, §8 items 1-2): the first mobile LIST binding, for S-071 mobile_parcel_disambiguation_map (render.projection map). modules gains mobile/src/components/surfaces/LotMapBinding.tsx (archetype LIST, owner the new promoted entry binding_mobile_list, the MF-48 D-2 a form) and SurfaceRenderer.tsx (the render half, owner shared_mobile_surface_binding) renders SEARCH, REPORT and LIST; mapping.mobile.LIST is the closed table of the map page, adding react-native-maps' own MapView, Polygon and Marker (configured by props; no hand-built part). libraries.mobile is NOT extended with react-native-maps: two Buildo-app files import it (LeadMapPane.tsx, map.tsx), the MF-48 L-1 precedent; the renderer imports it as a layout part (FE-31 C-8m MOBILE_PARTS). mounts gains the map page; non_display_keys gains the react-native-maps prop names that carry no display text. Dated note 2026-11-11 (MF-19; operator D-1..D-8 "all as recommmended", D-4): mounts gain the admin lot-size page files (page, client mount, error boundary) of admin_lot_size_revert; report_lot_size_entry has no mount until the entry switch flips (D-6). Dated note 2026-11-11 (MF-46 stage C; operator D-2 (a) "1 y 2 y ..." 2026-11-11; plan ~/Buildo-scratch/mcfrontend/MF-46/plan.md v3 section 12 fold 13; Spec 126 section 11b.5): + the first web STATIC module src/components/surfaces/web/StaticBinding.tsx (owner binding_web_static, promoted), mapping.web.STATIC (the closed list it renders: Stack, Group, Title, Text, List, ListItem and Button; a link is a Button rendered as the Next Link, a real route), and the mounts of the MaxBLD plain pages under src/app/(maxbld)/parcel-tool/(static)/ (Help & Support, Terms, Privacy, and the error and not-found boundaries of web_maxbld_error). No new library; non_display_keys unchanged. Dated note 2026-11-11 (MF-76 · McFrontend queue · lane E; operator D-1 (a), D-2 (a), D-3 (a) "3 y"; plan ~/Buildo-scratch/mcfrontend/MF-46/plan.md v3 section 12 folds 12, 13): mounts gains the landing (web_landing, parcel-tool/(static)/home/page.tsx; its errors reach the plain pages' boundary, already mounted). mapping.web.STATIC is unchanged: the landing kinds render with the same Mantine parts; the two report regions are the shared REPORT renderers (ReportView, its Picture, ReportPage), embedded by exact name and module as a named exception of the FE-31 C-8 lock (Spec 126 section 11b.1: REPORT keeps the landed renderer; FE-07), never a mapping entry. Server values are {"derived": <read>} refs (the existing kind, a closed list: the landing's declared reads). non_display_keys gains tabIndex (the sample region's keyboard stop, 0).
